verdict.rationale: The docs show the product serving as a model backend for coding agents. An integrations command points a tool at a model and starts it with no manual configuration. The `--cloud` flag is documented specifically for the opencode coding agent, choosing hosted over local models. The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so standard clients work by setting `base_url`. Community failure reports concern the separate rcli voice demo, not this integration path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of coding-agent integration, documentation of which coding agents beyond opencode are supported, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
